title: NVIDIA Corporate Timeline 1997
scope_note: Retrospective first-party chronology says NVIDIA launched RIVA 128 in April 1997 and reports later sales volume; it lacks a day and channel.

title: S3 announces ViRGE/MX for notebook PCs
scope_note: Contemporary report dates the domestic announcement and distinguishes current sampling from planned Q2 volume production.

title: ELSA announces PERMEDIA 2 support on WINNER and GLoria boards
scope_note: Manufacturer board-maker release identifies the PERMEDIA 2 chip and says associated boards will be available from September 1997.

title: Canopus announces PowerWindow cards using RIVA 128
scope_note: Contemporary report identifies PWR128P and PWR128P/4VC as PCI boards using RIVA 128 and gives end-of-October sales timing.

title: Melco announces WHP-PS PERMEDIA 2 graphics cards
scope_note: Contemporary report names two PCI board variants using PERMEDIA 2 and states late-October shipment.

title: ATI introduces Xpert graphics board
scope_note: Contemporary report identifies ATI Xpert as a board based on 3D Rage Pro and says PCI/AGP models would be available in August.
